tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to get one public release by slug.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to list public album and release records.

tools.name: pause_playback
tools.description: Pause only the visible browser player. This reversible action creates no server mutation and preserves the current track for later playback.

tools.name: play_track
tools.description: Play a published track only in the visible browser player. This reversible action creates no server mutation, can be paused, and may be blocked by browser autoplay policy.

tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to search the public music catalog.

tools.name: set_playback_queue
tools.description: Replace only the visible browser player queue with up to 20 published tracks. This reversible action creates no server mutation.
